features.title: Made to help you understand
features.subtitle: Explains, discusses and checks your understanding, like studying with a patient group, and you decide what to learn.

f1.title: A study group in every lesson
f1.body: A virtual teacher, virtual classmates and an assistant take part so each idea is explained from several sides.

f2.title: Slides and whiteboard
f2.body: Every lesson comes with slides, a live whiteboard and visual explanations.

f3.title: Quizzes and projects
f3.body: Check what you learned with quizzes, then practise in project-based tasks.

f4.title: Voice narration
f4.body: Scenes can be read aloud, and you can answer by voice.

f5.body: Join a class with a code, and share your courses with other members once an administrator has approved them.

f6.title: Take it with you

trust.title: Study with peace of mind

t1.title: You stay in charge
t1.body: The tools only help explain and practise. You choose what to learn, and you can stop at any time.

t2.title: Checked before it is shared
t2.body: An administrator reviews a course before other members can see it.

t3.title: Honest about limits
t3.body: A lesson can contain mistakes. For anything important, check with your teacher or your textbook.

t4.title: Look before you commit
t4.body: Free previews are open to everyone, with no account and no obligation.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Which grades and subjects does KHAITAM cover?
faq.a1: For now it starts with maths, informatics, physics and chemistry for grades 5, 9 and 12. More grades and subjects will be added over time.
faq.q2: Does trying a lesson cost anything?
faq.a2: No. Preview lessons are open to everyone, with no account and no strings attached. More previews are on the way.
faq.q3: How is this different from asking an ordinary chat app?
faq.a3: Every lesson comes with its structure: a teacher, slides, a whiteboard and check questions inside the lesson, so you do not have to think of what to ask. An administrator also reviews a course before other members see it.
faq.a4: It can. For anything important, check with your teacher or the textbook.
faq.a5: Not to try a preview. To create courses on the topics you need, join classes with an invite code and share courses, you need an account and a membership.
faq.a6: Membership starts at {{price}} a month, does not renew by itself and has no extra charges. For now you pay by bank transfer: write to {{email}} to choose a plan.

pillars.p2: Technology to expand what people can do

story.title: From big questions, · to real value.
story.body1: KHAITAM joins two ideas: the spirit of KHAI, which opens and explores, and the depth and humanity of TÂM.
story.body2: We believe that when intelligence, technology and people move together, today’s questions become tomorrow’s solutions.

v1.title: Openness
v1.body: Look far, discover what is new.

guest.lead: Every lesson in maths, informatics, physics or chemistry is interactive: a teacher who explains, slides, a whiteboard and check questions right inside the lesson, so you understand it before you practise.

intents.title: For students in grades 5, 9 and 12
intents.subtitle: Maths, informatics, physics and chemistry: learning something new or revising before a test, you can start with one short lesson. More grades and subjects will be added over time.

i1.title: Understand today’s lesson
i1.body: Each idea is explained step by step, with slides and a whiteboard so you can see how it is done.

i2.title: Revise before a test
i2.body: Pick the topic you need, replay what is shaky and answer questions to see where you are still weak.

i3.title: Practise a little more
i3.body: Take quizzes and small projects to use what you just learned, not just read it.

desc.doc-parse: Uploaded course materials (docs, slides, audio/video) are parsed into text; audio and video are transcribed automatically.
